experimental_method: N2 and O2 in air-free distilled water: modified Estreicher-Ostwald burette method (gas volume, pressure and temperature read before and after absorption in a bulb at 0-50 C, several pressures per run); CO2 in sea-water/distilled water at low CO2 partial pressure: equilibration by rotating bottle, CO2 pressure by Pettenkofer (Ba(OH)2) titration, total CO2 and alkalinity by gas extraction and titration.
uncertainties_stated: not stated as numbers; the author lists neglected-error considerations (residual air bubble 0.01-0.10 c.c. in earlier work, argon content of atmospheric nitrogen)
quality_remarks: Experiment I uses atmospheric nitrogen (1.185 % Ar): coefficients in that table are not corrected to pure nitrogen. Absorption coefficient reduced to 760 mm; temperature scale not stated (1909 mercury thermometers). Several printed cells are inconsistent with the other printed columns (see mapping notes: Exp I row 29.88 C; Exp IV rows 13.75, 29.88, 37.51 C; Exp III w_t 128.970 at 40.09 C; CO2 block 24.18 C p 4.73). CO2 'total CO2' is chemically bound plus free CO2 at alkalinity ~40 mg OH/l, not a physical solubility.
not_extracted_tables: Experiment II (nitrogen in distilled water): referred to in the text but not in this PDF
